impacts.reason: The impact is about the fee mechanism breaking when fees are accrued but not distributed; the stated intent that fees should normally be distributed on _update directly concerns this relation, and the preconditions describe the same-block accrual scenario.
LP value depletion is tied to undistributed accrued fees; the intent that fees should be distributed on _update directly concerns preventing this, with the same-block accrual preconditions.
Indirect fee theft arises when undistributed fees are counted as amountIn on the next swap; the explicit intent to exclude accrued fees from amountIn directly concerns this impact.
The feedback loop comes from inflated amountIn generating new fees; the explicit intent that new fees be computed only on true deposits directly concerns this impact.
Over-time LP value depletion follows from fees computed on inflated amountIn; the intent to compute fees only on true deposits directly concerns this impact.
Pricing corruption stems from accrued fees being counted as amountIn; the explicit intent to exclude accrued fees from amountIn directly concerns this impact.
Direct exploitation is enabled by the same amountIn miscounting; the explicit intent to exclude accrued fees from amountIn directly concerns this impact.
